purpose: External reference sources for the Human Digital Twin. References are metadata-only until a user explicitly downloads or imports data.

sources.title: 3D Model of an Anatomical Template of Healthy Adult Human Hand
sources.intendedUse: Reference geometry and spatial registration baseline
limitations: Template of healthy adult hands, not a subject-specific digital twin
Does not by itself provide tissue- or cell-level identity
Region IDs must be supplied or derived and validated before semantic picking

sources.title: HuBMAP Data Portal
sources.intendedUse: Reference tissue/cell/spatial/molecular datasets and provenance-aware adapters
limitations: Dataset availability depends on organ, specimen and assay
Reference observations must not be relabeled as observations of the current user
Download access and terms are controlled by the source portal

sources.title: Allen Cell Explorer / Cell Feature Explorer
sources.intendedUse: Reference 3D cell morphology, segmentation and cell-level feature data
limitations: Reference cell datasets are not cells from the user's hand
Cell line and assay context must remain attached to provenance
Do not infer hand-specific health or age from these data alone
